stories.headline: Prabowo returns from France with $3.5 billion in commercial deals after meeting Macron
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto completed a four-day state visit to Paris (May 26–29), meeting President Emmanuel Macron and signing four commercial agreements worth $3.5 billion covering defense, energy, and trade. A high-level Indonesia-France business council was launched, and Macron cited the Rafale jet delivery as a marker of deepening bilateral ties.

stories.headline: Controversy erupts over Prabowo's overseas travel frequency; palace denies Italy, Austria, Hungary extensions
stories.summary: Gerindra's spokesman claimed Prabowo would continue from France to Austria and Hungary, triggering speculation and flight-radar reports suggesting Italy. The presidential communications bureau firmly denied any stops beyond France, while PDI-P questioned the frequency of Prabowo's overseas trips and former deputy foreign minister Dino Patti Djalal publicly criticized the pace of foreign visits. The palace and Gerindra pushed back, framing the travel as geopolitical balancing.

stories.headline: Rupiah nears Rp18,000/USD; Bank Indonesia hikes rate 50bp to 5.25% and intervenes daily
stories.summary: The Indonesian rupiah weakened sharply during the Idul Adha holiday period, touching Rp17,949 per USD, prompting Bank Indonesia to defend the currency 'around the clock.' BI attributed pressure to Middle East conflict, high US interest rates, and domestic dollar demand; it had already raised the benchmark rate by 50 basis points to 5.25% in an out-of-cycle move. MSCI's decision to suspend index rebalancing linked to Indonesia and concerns about a possible downgrade to frontier market status added to investor anxiety.

stories.headline: Former Defense Minister and Army Chief General Ryamizard Ryacudu dies at 76
stories.summary: Retired General Ryamizard Ryacudu, who served as Army Chief of Staff (2002–2005) and Defense Minister under Jokowi (2014–2019), died at RSPAD Gatot Subroto Hospital on May 31. President Prabowo — a close military academy classmate — expressed condolences via Instagram and was set to attend the state funeral at Kalibata Heroes Cemetery on June 1. Military leaders, Megawati, and former VP Jusuf Kalla also paid tributes.

stories.headline: Viral song 'Mas Bahlil Ganteng' turns Golkar chairman into social media phenomenon ahead of 2029

Golkar's secretary-general and Bahlil himself responded positively; Bahlil said he wants to meet the anonymous creator. Party cadres argued the song reflects rising electability for a possible 2029 presidential run.

stories.headline: Danantara issues revised governance regulation; new export subsidiary DSI prepares management team
stories.summary: President Prabowo signed Government Regulation No. 16/2026 revising Danantara's organizational structure. Separately, Danantara's COO Dony Oskaria explained the sovereign wealth fund has not yet released financial statements — citing ongoing SOE balance-sheet cleaning and Rp100 trillion in impairments — while announcing PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI), a new entity to manage commodity exports under a one-gate system, with management team to be announced the following week.

stories.headline: TNI Navy intercepts 390 tonnes of allegedly radioactive illegal minerals at Batam
stories.summary: TNI's Naval Command intercepted a vessel carrying 25 containers — approximately 390 tonnes — of mineral ore including ilmenite (containing titanium oxide and rare earth elements) in Batam waters on May 17, with results confirmed later in the week. The Satgas PKH forestry task force and the Attorney General's Office were involved; Indonesia's Chief of Staff stated naval patrols would be intensified.

stories.headline: Academics at Gadjah Mada University warn of remilitarization and democratic backsliding under Prabowo
stories.summary: Hundreds of academics, activists, and civil society members gathered at Gadjah Mada University in Yogyakarta to discuss the strengthening of military influence in civilian affairs under the Prabowo-Gibran government. Researcher Saiful Mujani called for a boycott of the 2029 election if democratic conditions do not improve, citing the 2024 election process as fundamentally flawed.

stories.headline: Indonesia issues presidential decree allowing state agency to import oil, potentially including from Russia
stories.summary: Perpres No. 26/2026, signed by Prabowo, allows a public service agency (BLU/Lemigas) to import crude oil and LPG for energy security, in addition to state-owned Pertamina. Analysts noted the decree opens a path for oil procurement from Russia and raises transparency and efficiency questions.
